scope: Parity between payload/ in this repository and the canonical publication at https://permeatelab.com/research/northwest-florida-engineering-costs/. The policy verifies delivered bytes. It does not validate screenshot image contents, claim raw HTML byte equality, or certify data provenance.

non_html.description: Live response body must equal the payload file byte for byte.

html.description: Live body must equal the payload file exactly, or equal the payload file with exactly one host block inserted immediately before the sole closing head tag. The block must match the recorded block byte for byte except the image filename, which must be identical in the og:image and twitter:image tags and must match image_url_pattern. Extra tags or scripts, a different host or project prefix, unequal image URLs, a changed title, a moved block, a second block, a second closing head tag, or any edit to the source bytes are rejected.
html.block_template: <script defer src="/~flock.js" data-proxy-url="/~api/analytics"></script><meta name="twitter:title" content="{title}"><meta property="og:image" content="{image}"><meta name="twitter:image" content="{image}">
html.record_on_change: When the image URL differs from the previously recorded one, the verifier reports the change and the regenerated manifest records the new URL. A URL change alone is not a parity failure.
